root_cause.text: The ICMP error delivery logic in the IPv4 and IPv6 network stacks fails to exclude `IPPROTO_RAW` sockets from receiving incoming ICMP error packets, allowing crafted packets to match these sockets contrary to the protocol specification.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit checks `if (protocol == IPPROTO_RAW)` in `net/ipv4/icmp.c`'s `icmp_socket_deliver` and `if (nexthdr == IPPROTO_RAW)` in `net/ipv6/icmp.c`'s `icmpv6_notify` to drop these packets before they reach the socket layer.

vuln_statements.content: static void icmp_socket_deliver(struct sk_buff *skb, u32 info)

vuln_statements.stmt_text: static void icmp_socket_deliver(struct sk_buff *skb, u32 info)
vuln_statements.explanation: This function contains the ICMP error delivery logic that fails to exclude IPPROTO_RAW sockets from receiving incoming ICMP error packets. The vulnerability root cause indicates that the socket matching logic within this function does not properly filter out raw protocol sockets, allowing crafted ICMP error packets to match these sockets contrary to protocol specification.
